top.title: The Stephen King multiverse
top.lede: The Dark Tower stands at the center and holds up every world. Around it lie the regions, each with its own color and the names that were born there. Select a region or a name to see the connections.

explore.intro: Every book has a synopsis and explained connections. Every place, character and concept has a profile and the list of books it runs through. The synopses avoid spoilers. The profiles do not.

credits.label: Sources and credits
credits.sources.title: Sources
credits.sources.text: The foundation is Stephen King's books. Dates, names and details were checked against the author's official website, Wikipedia and the Stephen King Wiki. Each profile cites the pages it used.
credits.map.title: About the map
credits.map.text: A navigable version of the many maps and flowcharts of King's universe that circulate among fans. Some connections were checked against the flowchart The Stephen King Universe, by Gillian James.
credits.licenses.title: Licenses
credits.licenses.text: Wikipedia and the Stephen King Wiki are published under the CC BY-SA license and were used only to check facts. The texts in this guide are original.
